column_semantics: The schedule uses a single Interest Rate (2) column, but PIK-bearing rows split that cell into a cash rate followed by a separate PIK rate, e.g. '6.70 % cash/ 1.75 % PIK'. The stated interest-rate percentage before 'cash/' is the cash leg only; the PIK percentage is quoted separately and is additive, not included in the cash rate.

rationale: The printed schedule header has one Interest Rate (2) column, but the filer's PIK-bearing positions consistently print the interest-rate cell as '[cash rate] cash/ [PIK rate] PIK'. That presentation separates the cash leg from the PIK leg, so the stated position-level interest rate is the cash leg only and the PIK rate is quoted separately on top. Searches for a separate PIK explanatory footnote or paid-in-kind note in the schedule did not find one; the row text itself supplies the convention.
